sql_templates.description: Selects latest events for each symbol that occurred within the last week, joining with results analysis and stage snapshot data.
sql_templates.template:
WITH ranked_events AS (
    SELECT 
        ce.symbol, 
        ce.event_date, 
        ce.event_type, 
        ce.purpose_raw, 
        ce.detail, 
        ce.source, 
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ce.symbol ORDER BY ce.event_date DESC) as rnk
    FROM signals.corporate_events ce
    WHERE ce.event_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '7 days'
)
SELECT 
    re.symbol, 
    re.event_date, 
    re.event_type, 
    re.purpose_raw, 
    re.detail, 
    ra.company_name, 
    ra.industry, 
    ra.verdict, 
    ss.stage, 
    ss.trading_signal
FROM ranked_events re
JOIN scores.results_analysis ra ON re.symbol = ra.symbol
JOIN scores.stage_snapshots ss ON re.symbol = ss.symbol
WHERE re.rnk = 1;
